```bash

  -d '{"requestId":"g-s1","subjectKey":"s1","purpose":"RESEARCH"}'
curl -X POST localhost:8080/api/v1/consents/grants -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"requestId":"g-s2","subjectKey":"s2","purpose":"RESEARCH"}'

  -d '{"requestId":"g-s3","subjectKey":"s3","purpose":"RESEARCH"}'

  -d '{"requestId":"n-s1","subjectKey":"s1","purpose":"RESEARCH","recordKey":"rec-1","value":2}'
curl -X POST localhost:8080/api/v1/numeric-records -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"requestId":"n-s2","subjectKey":"s2","purpose":"RESEARCH","recordKey":"rec-1","value":3}'
curl -X POST localhost:8080/api/v1/numeric-records -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"requestId":"n-s3","subjectKey":"s3","purpose":"RESEARCH","recordKey":"rec-1","value":4}'

        {"subjectKey":"s1","epoch":1,"recordKey":"rec-1"},

        {"subjectKey":"s3","epoch":1,"recordKey":"rec-1"}]}'

| POST | `/api/v1/consents/grants` | 授权/复用当前代次 |

| POST | `/api/v1/numeric-records` | 数值记录写入（0-1000 非负整数，仅回元数据） |
| POST | `/api/v1/cohort-aggregates` | 最小群体汇总（仅 RESEARCH，3-10 个不同主体） |
